shortDesc: VS Code extension to create serial date-based C++ templates and archive binaries.
fullDesc:
AUTO DATE is a custom VS Code extension published to the Visual Studio Code Marketplace, designed to streamline file creation and directory management for competitive programmers and C++ developers.

Core Idea:
The extension automates the creation of serial, date-based source files (named in the format YYYYMMDD-Serial.cpp) in the workspace root, initializing them with a boilerplate template. It also helps developers maintain a clean workspace by archiving source codes and compiled binaries into a dedicated folder with a keyboard shortcut.
highlights: Creates date-named C++ templates instantly via Ctrl+N Ctrl+C
Cleans and archives compiled binaries and source codes via Ctrl+N Ctrl+M
Lightweight and optimized bundling using esbuild
